title: PINNing the pion: conformal deep learning for $F_\pi(s)$ and the $(g-2)_\mu$ hadronic contribution
abstract: arXiv:2609.40008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extracting the pion electromagnetic form factor $F_{\pi}(s)$ through phenomenological curve-fitting models introduces model dependence, unphysical artefacts, and kinematic inconsistencies. We introduce a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) embedded in a conformal $z$-plane that constructs $F_{\pi}(s)$ directly from first principles across spacelike and timelike domains: charge normalisation and Schwarz reflection are enforced by construction, while Cauchy-Riemann analyticity, dispersion relations, Watson's theorem, and perturbative QCD asymptotics enter through the loss functional. Thus, the fundamental S-matrix principles dictate the form factor's behaviour while data act as constraints. Mapping the cut complex plane onto the unit disk bounds the Hessian norm and prevents Neural Tangent Kernel spectral starvation, two known failure modes of deep-learning optimisation. translated_title: PINN锁定π介子：用于F_π(s)与(g-2)_μ强子贡献的共形深度学习
translated_abstract: 通过唯象曲线拟合模型提取π介子电磁形状因子F_π(s)会引入模型依赖性、非物理伪影和运动学不一致性。我们引入一种嵌入共形z平面的物理信息神经网络（PINN），直接从第一性原理构建跨类空与类时域的F_π(s)：电荷归一化和Schwarz反射在构造上即被强制满足，而Cauchy-Riemann解析性、色散关系、Watson定理以及微扰QCD渐近行为则通过损失泛函纳入。由此，基本S矩阵原理决定了形状因子的行为，而数据仅充当约束。将带割缝的复平面映射到单位圆盘上，限制了Hessian范数并防止了神经正切核（NTK）的谱退化——这是深度学习优化中两种已知的失效模式。除e⁺e⁻散射数据外，我们还纳入了τ衰变数据（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 提出一种嵌入共形z平面的物理信息神经网络（PINN），将解析性、色散关系、Watson定理和微扰QCD渐近等S矩阵基本原理编码进损失函数，从而从第一性原理直接构建π介子电磁形状因子F_π(s)，为μ子反常磁矩(g-2)_μ的强子贡献提供无模型依赖的计算方法。
en_tdlr: A physics-informed neural network embedded in a conformal z-plane constructs the pion electromagnetic form factor F_π(s) from first principles by encoding S-matrix principles—analyticity, dispersion relations, Watson's theorem, and pQCD asymptotics—into the loss functional, enabling a model-independent determination of the hadronic contribution to (g-2)_μ.
